title: crataegus monogyna subsp. azarella
intro: Crataegus monogyna subsp. azarella, commonly known as Irish hawthorn, is a subspecies of hawthorn tree native to Ireland and other parts of Western Europe. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits such as lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Irish hawthorn include acting as a vasodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which help to protect against cardiovascular disease and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Irish hawthorn include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
